2. 高效能插幀串流正式上線：
* 原生 HDR 支援
* 至少支援 A15 以上裝置進行穩定的 60 → 120 FPS 插幀串流
* 中間影格解析度檔位可自由調整，平衡插幀畫質與效能開銷

3. 繪畫進階套件
經過調校與優化的筆跡透傳、專業級壓力曲線映射、雙擊及捏合快捷鍵、專屬螢幕顯示按鍵。
（繪畫進階套件為 App 內購項目，未購買不影響基礎手寫筆功能之使用）

4. 強大的觸控支援
 * 流暢穩定的多點觸控透傳。
 * 本應用首創的「多點觸控遊戲微調」功能，進一步優化 PC 原生行動 UI 遊戲的操作體驗。

5. 強化外接手把支援

 * 可指定手把對應類型為 Xbox360 或 DS4。
 * 自訂手把滑鼠模式。
 * 自訂陀螺儀切換與長按保持按鍵。
 * 串流過程中可隨時連接手把。
 * 支援陀螺儀對應（iOS 14+），可於內建陀螺儀與手把陀螺儀之間熱切換。

6. 進階螢幕顯示控制項
 * 按鍵類型包含：手把、鍵盤、滑鼠、陀螺儀控制、功能鍵（設定選單、虛擬鍵盤等）。
 * 支援控制項的分組、分層、摺疊與展開，控制項群組可快速匯入並重複使用整個版面配置。
 * 支援組合按鍵、按鍵巨集、按鍵＋觸控板混合控制項。
 * 提供行動端遊戲體驗的觸控板控制項。
 * 按鍵可設定獨立連點功能。
 * 提供視覺與觸覺回饋（需裝置具備震動馬達）。
 * 控制項參數面板支援自訂調整大小、形狀、邊框、透明度、靈敏度、標籤等屬性。
 * 支援匯入與匯出控制項版面配置，跨裝置分享你的遊戲操作設定。

7. 強大的體感控制
 * 可直接將內建陀螺儀、外接手把陀螺儀對應為滑鼠或手把搖桿，無需 PC 端第三方軟體對應。

注意：外接手把震動需 iOS 14+ 支援。

hk.description:
Ten miniature machines from decades of computing sit on the table in front of you, each with a working screen and a keyboard you can type on. Spend a little time with an old favourite, or discover the computer your parents grew up with.

Some computers stay with you long after you stop using them. Now there's room for them on your desk again.

EXPLORE THE COLLECTION

Ten computers are ready to play with, inspired by the Macintosh, Commodore 64, IBM PC, Amiga 500, Windows 95, ThinkPad, iMac G3, iBook G3, PowerBook G4 and Windows XP.

TYPE, DRAW AND PLAY

Enjoy clicking keyboards, working command lines, paint programs, floppy disks and familiar desktop games. Open windows, write a note, draw something small and explore each computer's personality. Type 10 PRINT on the Commodore, run BASICA ROOFTOP at the DOS prompt, or load BRICKS from the Amiga's floppy. Occasionally, even Windows crashes.

FIFTY NOSTALGIC SECRETS

Every computer hides five nostalgic secrets: pieces of real computing history, a hidden game and, where its era had them, screen savers. Turn on the Hot Dog Stand colour scheme, ask the 1541 for its directory, meet Rover, or fill a 1984 Mac's memory until the bomb appears. Each computer's page in the collection keeps track of what you've found. Stuck? Open a hint, one at a time: what it is, where to look, then exactly what to do.

ON IPHONE AND IPAD

Each computer appears on your screen as a real little machine resting on an oak table, with its own case, keys and controls. On iPad, the whole computer is in front of you. On iPhone, turn sideways to see the whole machine, then zoom into its screen or its keyboard.

ON IPHONE DUO, IT BECOMES THE COMPUTER

iPhone Duo is the special case. Fold your Duo into tabletop mode and the phone itself transforms into the computer: the screen stands up above and a working keyboard lies flat below, so you hold and type on the machine itself. Close your Duo to browse the collection and choose your next exhibit.

All ten computers are included. No ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases.

VoidLink 是由 Sunshine - Moonlight 串流社群玩家維護、主導的專案。經過長期開發迭代，已打磨為效能強大、功能豐富的遊戲串流工具。

1. 串流效能提升
 * VoidLink 標準視訊渲染管線，提供無可比擬的串流效能與參考級 HDR 準確性。詳情請見 App 技術支援網頁。
 * 支援 YUV 4:4:4 串流（需裝置硬體解碼支援）。
 * 支援子母畫面模式（iOS 15+），可於背景持續串流不中斷。

2. 高效能插幀串流正式上線：
* 原生 HDR 支援
* 至少支援 A15 以上裝置進行穩定的 60 → 120 FPS 插幀串流
* 中間影格解析度檔位可自由調整，平衡插幀畫質與效能開銷
* 串流解析度可配合插幀功能縮小（減少插幀造成的閃爍感）

3. 繪畫進階套件
經過調校與優化的筆跡透傳、專業級壓力曲線映射、雙擊及捏合快捷鍵、專屬螢幕顯示按鍵。
（繪畫進階套件為 App 內購項目，未購買不影響基礎手寫筆功能之使用）

4. 強大的觸控支援
 * 流暢穩定的多點觸控透傳。
 * 本應用首創的「多點觸控遊戲微調」功能，進一步優化 PC 原生行動 UI 遊戲的操作體驗。
 * 提供類筆記型電腦觸控板的滑鼠單擊、右鍵、拖曳等觸控操作方式，並可調整游標移動靈敏度。

5. 強化外接手把支援
 * 環形選單、手把全域導覽，覆蓋手把串流玩家 95% 的 App 設定與操作，掌機體驗無須觸控螢幕！
 * 超好玩！VoidLink 實現遊戲串流社群首個手把可視化回饋疊層。
 * 可指定手把對應類型為 Xbox360 或 DS4。
 * 自訂手把滑鼠模式。
 * 自訂陀螺儀切換與長按保持按鍵。
 * 串流過程中可隨時連接手把。
 * 支援陀螺儀對應（iOS 14+），可於內建陀螺儀與手把陀螺儀之間熱切換。

6. 進階螢幕顯示控制項
 * 按鍵類型包含：手把、鍵盤、滑鼠、陀螺儀控制、功能鍵（設定選單、虛擬鍵盤等）。
 * 支援控制項的分組、分層、摺疊與展開，控制項群組可快速匯入並重複使用整個版面配置。
 * 支援組合按鍵、按鍵巨集、按鍵＋觸控板混合控制項。
 * 提供行動端遊戲體驗的觸控板控制項。
 * 按鍵可設定獨立連點功能。
 * 提供視覺與觸覺回饋（需裝置具備震動馬達）。
 * 控制項參數面板支援自訂調整大小、形狀、邊框、透明度、靈敏度、標籤等屬性。
 * 支援匯入與匯出控制項版面配置，跨裝置分享你的遊戲操作設定。

7. 強大的體感控制
 * 可直接將內建陀螺儀、外接手把陀螺儀對應為滑鼠或手把搖桿，無需 PC 端第三方軟體對應。
 * 可搭配陀螺儀螢幕顯示按鍵「GYRO」、「GYROPAUSE」或自訂手把按鍵進行體感控制。

8. 震動引擎選擇（iOS 13+）
 * 自動：當手把不支援震動時，改由 iPhone 本體震動；未連接實體手把、僅使用螢幕顯示控制項時，同樣可觸發 iPhone 震動。
 * 內建：強制使用 iPhone 內建震動。
 * 左右對調：交換手把左右握把馬達的震動。
 * 關閉：停用所有震動效果。
注意：外接手把震動需 iOS 14+ 支援。

9. 搭配 Sunshine 基地版使用時，碼率上限可隨時調整，無需中斷連線。

10.搭配 Sunshine 基地版使用時，支援麥克風重新導向。

11. 完整直向模式支援
 * 串流畫面與控制項可適配直向顯示，自動調整解析度與螢幕顯示版面配置。

12. 外接顯示器支援
 * 支援鏡像模式或僅外接顯示器顯示。

mo.description:
Ten miniature machines from decades of computing sit on the table in front of you, each with a working screen and a keyboard you can type on. Spend a little time with an old favourite, or discover the computer your parents grew up with.

Some computers stay with you long after you stop using them. Now there's room for them on your desk again.

EXPLORE THE COLLECTION

Ten computers are ready to play with, inspired by the Macintosh, Commodore 64, IBM PC, Amiga 500, Windows 95, ThinkPad, iMac G3, iBook G3, PowerBook G4 and Windows XP.

TYPE, DRAW AND PLAY

Enjoy clicking keyboards, working command lines, paint programs, floppy disks and familiar desktop games. Open windows, write a note, draw something small and explore each computer's personality. Type 10 PRINT on the Commodore, run BASICA ROOFTOP at the DOS prompt, or load BRICKS from the Amiga's floppy. Occasionally, even Windows crashes.

FIFTY NOSTALGIC SECRETS

Every computer hides five nostalgic secrets: pieces of real computing history, a hidden game and, where its era had them, screen savers. Turn on the Hot Dog Stand colour scheme, ask the 1541 for its directory, meet Rover, or fill a 1984 Mac's memory until the bomb appears. Each computer's page in the collection keeps track of what you've found. Stuck? Open a hint, one at a time: what it is, where to look, then exactly what to do.

ON IPHONE AND IPAD

Each computer appears on your screen as a real little machine resting on an oak table, with its own case, keys and controls. On iPad, the whole computer is in front of you. On iPhone, turn sideways to see the whole machine, then zoom into its screen or its keyboard.

ON IPHONE DUO, IT BECOMES THE COMPUTER

iPhone Duo is the special case. Fold your Duo into tabletop mode and the phone itself transforms into the computer: the screen stands up above and a working keyboard lies flat below, so you hold and type on the machine itself. Close your Duo to browse the collection and choose your next exhibit.

All ten computers are included. No ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases.

tw.description:
Ten miniature machines from decades of computing sit on the table in front of you, each with a working screen and a keyboard you can type on. Spend a little time with an old favourite, or discover the computer your parents grew up with.

Some computers stay with you long after you stop using them. Now there's room for them on your desk again.

EXPLORE THE COLLECTION

Ten computers are ready to play with, inspired by the Macintosh, Commodore 64, IBM PC, Amiga 500, Windows 95, ThinkPad, iMac G3, iBook G3, PowerBook G4 and Windows XP.

TYPE, DRAW AND PLAY

Enjoy clicking keyboards, working command lines, paint programs, floppy disks and familiar desktop games. Open windows, write a note, draw something small and explore each computer's personality. Type 10 PRINT on the Commodore, run BASICA ROOFTOP at the DOS prompt, or load BRICKS from the Amiga's floppy. Occasionally, even Windows crashes.

FIFTY NOSTALGIC SECRETS

Every computer hides five nostalgic secrets: pieces of real computing history, a hidden game and, where its era had them, screen savers. Turn on the Hot Dog Stand colour scheme, ask the 1541 for its directory, meet Rover, or fill a 1984 Mac's memory until the bomb appears. Each computer's page in the collection keeps track of what you've found. Stuck? Open a hint, one at a time: what it is, where to look, then exactly what to do.

ON IPHONE AND IPAD

Each computer appears on your screen as a real little machine resting on an oak table, with its own case, keys and controls. On iPad, the whole computer is in front of you. On iPhone, turn sideways to see the whole machine, then zoom into its screen or its keyboard.

ON IPHONE DUO, IT BECOMES THE COMPUTER

iPhone Duo is the special case. Fold your Duo into tabletop mode and the phone itself transforms into the computer: the screen stands up above and a working keyboard lies flat below, so you hold and type on the machine itself. Close your Duo to browse the collection and choose your next exhibit.

All ten computers are included. No ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases.

Usa uma interface de áudio externa? Agora você pode escolher exatamente qual canal de entrada o Tuner T1 deve escutar. Conecte uma interface de áudio multicanal compatível e selecione o canal desejado diretamente no app. Seja para gravar em estúdio, conectar instrumentos por uma interface de áudio ou trabalhar com uma configuração profissional, você agora tem mais controle sobre a entrada usada para afinar.

Novo filtro Lo Cut: afinação mais limpa em ambientes ruidosos

Apresentamos o Lo Cut, uma nova opção de filtragem de áudio que permite eliminar frequências abaixo de um limite selecionado.

Ruídos graves de aparelhos de ar-condicionado, trânsito, vibrações do palco e outras fontes de ruído ambiente podem interferir na detecção da afinação. Com o Lo Cut, você pode reduzir essas frequências indesejadas, ajudando o Tuner T1 a se concentrar no som do seu instrumento para uma afinação mais estável e precisa.

Especialmente útil em apresentações ao vivo, salas de ensaio e ambientes ruidosos. Para baixos e outros instrumentos de registro grave, escolha uma frequência de corte mais baixa para preservar as frequências fundamentais necessárias à afinação.

Desempenho significativamente aprimorado

Fizemos grandes otimizações internas para tornar o Tuner T1 mais rápido, fluido e responsivo. Da detecção de afinação em tempo real às animações na tela e à navegação geral, tudo está mais suave e refinado.

Tenha uma experiência de afinação ainda melhor, seja praticando em casa, tocando no palco ou trabalhando no estúdio.

Obrigado por usar o Tuner T1 Pro. Seu feedback nos ajuda a continuar melhorando.

Afinador T1 é o afinador de instrumentos definitivo, projetado para afinar com precisão uma ampla variedade de instrumentos musicais. Quer esteja a afinar uma guitarra, violino, viola, baixo, piano, violoncelo, flauta ou qualquer outro instrumento, o Afinador T1 garante uma precisão impecável e facilidade de uso. Ideal para músicos profissionais e iniciantes, esta app de afinador cromático é criada para lidar com todos os instrumentos comuns com precisão incrível, tornando-se uma ferramenta essencial para qualquer músico.

Características principais:

• Latência de deteção personalizável: Adapte a aplicação às suas necessidades específicas ajustando a latência de deteção de pitch. Definições de latência mais baixas permitem uma deteção de pitch mais rápida, ideal para práticas vocais rápidas. Definições de latência mais altas ajudam a filtrar ruídos indesejados e sons momentâneos, fornecendo resultados de afinação estáveis – especialmente útil para afinações precisas de instrumentos.

Por que escolher o Afinador T1?

O Afinador T1 destaca-se de outras apps de afinação devido à sua precisão superior e deteção de pitch de baixa latência, otimizada especificamente para afinar uma ampla gama de instrumentos comuns. Esta app foi construída para satisfazer as necessidades de guitarristas, violinistas, pianistas e outros músicos de diferentes géneros. Com a sua interface elegante, configurações personalizáveis e capacidade de gerar tons, o Afinador T1 é não apenas poderoso, mas também incrivelmente fácil de usar.

Libere o seu potencial musical

Com o Afinador T1, não está apenas a obter um afinador comum. Está a obter uma ferramenta que o ajuda a alcançar a afinação perfeita, aprimorar o seu ouvido e melhorar o seu desempenho. Quer esteja a praticar, a gravar ou a atuar ao vivo, o Afinador T1 oferece-lhe a precisão de afinação de nível profissional de que necessita.

Faça o download do Afinador T1 hoje e experimente o próximo nível de precisão de afinação para todos os seus instrumentos musicais!

pt.description:
Ten miniature machines from decades of computing sit on the table in front of you, each with a working screen and a keyboard you can type on. Spend a little time with an old favourite, or discover the computer your parents grew up with.

Some computers stay with you long after you stop using them. Now there's room for them on your desk again.

EXPLORE THE COLLECTION

Ten computers are ready to play with, inspired by the Macintosh, Commodore 64, IBM PC, Amiga 500, Windows 95, ThinkPad, iMac G3, iBook G3, PowerBook G4 and Windows XP.

TYPE, DRAW AND PLAY

Enjoy clicking keyboards, working command lines, paint programs, floppy disks and familiar desktop games. Open windows, write a note, draw something small and explore each computer's personality. Type 10 PRINT on the Commodore, run BASICA ROOFTOP at the DOS prompt, or load BRICKS from the Amiga's floppy. Occasionally, even Windows crashes.

FIFTY NOSTALGIC SECRETS

Every computer hides five nostalgic secrets: pieces of real computing history, a hidden game and, where its era had them, screen savers. Turn on the Hot Dog Stand colour scheme, ask the 1541 for its directory, meet Rover, or fill a 1984 Mac's memory until the bomb appears. Each computer's page in the collection keeps track of what you've found. Stuck? Open a hint, one at a time: what it is, where to look, then exactly what to do.

ON IPHONE AND IPAD

Each computer appears on your screen as a real little machine resting on an oak table, with its own case, keys and controls. On iPad, the whole computer is in front of you. On iPhone, turn sideways to see the whole machine, then zoom into its screen or its keyboard.

ON IPHONE DUO, IT BECOMES THE COMPUTER

iPhone Duo is the special case. Fold your Duo into tabletop mode and the phone itself transforms into the computer: the screen stands up above and a working keyboard lies flat below, so you hold and type on the machine itself. Close your Duo to browse the collection and choose your next exhibit.

All ten computers are included. No ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases.

《五道門》1.0.4 現已推出！本次更新帶來全新玩法「鎮妖塔」與多項系統升級，感謝各位俠士的支持與回饋。

【全新內容】 ・鎮妖塔：全新爬塔玩法正式開放——三大入口、十四層逐層挑戰，守層精英鎮守其中，換層免費；十七件「鎮妖套裝」與鎮妖令首度亮相，集齊套裝可點亮套裝效果；塔內禁止切磋、離塔回原位，重新登入不掉進度。 ・會員體系：新增初級／中級／高級會員檔位與專屬徽章，多項會員特權與每日首充補領同步上線。 ・福利中心：新增每日簽到等福利玩法，天天登入天天領獎。 ・聲望商店：聲望兌換正式開放，闖蕩江湖累積的聲望可以換取珍稀物品了。 ・江湖禮包：三大裝備匣全面升級——必得套裝部位與幸運寶石，開匣即見真章。 ・拍賣行：上架手續費逐件明細顯示，定價與扣費一目了然。 ・強化系統：高級強化石效果提升至 1.5 倍，並新增幸運寶石保底券，強化更加安心。 ・經濟調整：經驗符文與經驗卷軸全面調價，卷軸新增擊殺保底，經驗收益更有保障。 ・角色管理：新增帳號角色列表，多角色的查看與切換更加方便。 ・戰報強化：戰報記錄更完整，斷線重連後的戰鬥體驗更穩定。 ・主線任務的獎勵說明改為顯示實際可獲得的內容。

【改進與最佳化】 ・數百項物品圖示全面翻新：寶石、裝備匣、會員卡、鑰匙等物品一眼即識。 ・NPC 頭像與場景入口圖示大幅優化，江湖更加賞心悅目。 ・寶石鑲嵌介面改進：新增屬性對比視圖與鑲嵌槽滿提示。 ・遊戲內名詞與繁體中文顯示全面校訂。

【問題修正】 ・修正新手試煉可能卡在 4/5 無法完成的問題，試煉彈窗新增「稍後再說」，不再強制打斷闖蕩。 ・修正武學屬性「魔晶增幅」文字黏連與換行異常，並清理過時的戰鬥按鈕。 ・修正 iOS 頂部／底部出現多餘留白、以及畫面整體下移的顯示問題。 ・修正底欄切換頁面時誤報「上一個操作處理中」的問題。 ・修正部分裝備圖示顯示錯誤的問題。 ・修正寶石顏色顯示異常與鑲嵌相關介面問題。 ・修正多處簡繁轉換與文字顯示問題。

如有任何問題或建議，歡迎透過遊戲內客服與我們聯繫。祝各位俠士江湖之行一路順遂！
